notes: Version 2.5 corrects the attribution of recursive non-injectivity, the hypotheses of the metric extraction and a notation collision. ENI Corollary 6 proves non-injectivity at every stratum of a tower of projections under its own premises on each projection (surjectivity, observables defined by the projection, a level not isomorphic to the one below); these premises are not consequences of the axioms A1-A4, and their verification for the strata proposed by the programme is open, as it is for the local transition map of A2. The introduction, the axiom section, the comparison with the Page-Wootters model and Table 1 state the ENI result with its premises. The identification of the effective metric from the principal symbol of the limit operator (Q5b) is conditional on the spatial limit hypothesis [H-L] and on the open lifting hypothesis [H-lift], and the signature result also on the hyperbolicity hypothesis of the Born-Infeld paper, giving (-,+,+) on the rank-three non-degenerate block only, a Lorentzian signature requiring a full-rank extension that is not constructed; the stale Q5b version label is removed. The finite Weil modules of the supplied Heisenberg-Schrödinger carrier are now written W, one for each non-trivial central character; the member at c is the Weil block V_c of O27, on which the Weil action is not the Heisenberg action; V_rho denotes only the spinor carrier C^2 supplied conditionally by O23. The notation identifies neither W nor V_c with the admissible fibre or with the spinor carrier. The abstract, the organisation paragraph, the README and Table 1 state that the proto-state is defined and that its structural indeterminacy is derived from A1 and A3, and that A3 preserves the open directions but does not by itself forbid an erasure of their relative phases. The cover shows the version. Table 1 and three displayed equations are reset within the page. No Foundation theorem is changed.
